$comment: Schema definition revision 1 (this file's own maintenance history, tracked separately from the `version` property below, which is what each *contract instance* declares itself conformant with). Bumping either one is a schema/tooling change and takes the slow path in ADR-006: platform release review, a semantic version tag, and a migration plan for every contract already in the repository. Pydantic models in src/uc_metadata/models.py are hand-kept in sync with this file field-for-field; see that module's docstring for which of the two is the enforced source of truth at runtime.
title: UC Metadata Contract
description: One human-readable, version-controlled file per dataset holding everything the platform and its consumers need to know about that dataset: ownership, refresh commitments, retention, certification tier, sensitivity, and a description per column (see Glossary: Contract in specs/F-PLATFORM-001-uc-metadata-contracts.md).

version.description: Contract schema version this document conforms to. A contract written against a newer schema than a given tool understands must fail loudly rather than silently drop fields.

columns.description: One entry per column. Harvested facts (name, data_type, nullable, partition_key) are never hand-authored; the judgment fields (description, business_term, pii, sensitivity) are proposed by the AI drafter and reviewed by a human.

certification.description: Earned from dq_registry.yaml evidence at validate time, not self-declared.

description.description: Human-declared dataset summary. Never AI-authored, so it carries no ai_proposed marker.

sensitivity.description: AI-suggested, human-decided dataset-level sensitivity classification. Absent until propose has run; present without ai_proposed:false blocks apply.

qualifier.description: The dataset's three-part Unity Catalog identity. Harvested, never hand-authored.

ownerPointer.description: Ownership recorded as a reference to the authoritative upstream system, never copied as a free-text value (Glossary: Owner pointer). Resolved to a team, solution owner and contact channel by owner_registry.resolve_owner(...) at read time, not stored here.

cadence.description: Human-declared refresh commitment, e.g. 'hourly', 'daily', 'weekly'. Declared, never measured (Out of Scope: Freshness observation).

sla_minutes.description: Minutes after the cadence boundary the refresh is due before it counts as a breach.

proposedBase.description: Base shape of the AI-proposed / unreviewed marker (Glossary: AI-proposed / unreviewed marker). ai_proposed:true means the value came from the AI drafter and no named human has accepted it yet; apply refuses a contract whole if any field still carries it (SC-001-03).

note.description: Set by the drafter when it had to guess between two plausible meanings, so a reviewer's attention lands where it matters. Never set on a human-authored value.

column.description: name, data_type, nullable and partition_key are harvested facts. description, business_term, pii and sensitivity are judgment fields, absent until propose has run and each wrapped in the AI-proposed marker while unreviewed.

business_term.description: Must resolve to a real glossary/ entry once accepted; not enforced at the schema level.
